# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest minor release of `torchsom`. Please upgrade to the latest release before reporting a problem.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for a security problem. Report it privately through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/michelin/TorchSOM/security/advisories/new) (the "Report a vulnerability" button on the Security tab).

Include a description of the problem, the affected version, and the steps to reproduce it. You'll be told promptly that the report is being handled. Depending on its severity, a confirmed vulnerability is generally fixed within 90 to 120 days.
